messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["pangolin", "axolotl"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right profile walking to the right, with a highly arched back and body almost entirely covered in large overlapping brown pangolin-like scales from the top of the head down the back and onto the tail. The head is pale pink, smooth and axolotl-like with a broad blunt snout, large dark round eyes, and a wide slightly smiling mouth. Behind the head on both sides of the neck are multiple pink feathery external gills. The underside and parts of the legs show pale wrinkled bare skin. It stands on four short thick legs ending in pale clawed feet with dark claws, and has a long tapering scaly tail extending to the rear left.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "pale pink smooth blunt-snouted axolotl-like head with glossy skin", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round black eyes with pale blue-grey irises", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "wide slightly upturned slit with small pink nostril dots above it", "part": "mouth and nose", "where": "at the front of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "pink fleshy stalks with fine feathery filaments, four on the near side and several visible on the far side", "part": "gills", "where": "on both sides of the neck just behind the head"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping brown keratin plates with lighter edges", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the back, sides, top of head, upper legs, and tail"}, {"looks_like": "short thick stout limbs partly scaled on top and pale wrinkled skin below", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "pale fleshy toes with short dark conical claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering scale-covered extension", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the rear left from the back of the body"}, {"looks_like": "pale cream wrinkled bare skin", "part": "belly skin", "where": "on the underside of the torso between the legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
